mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Warm Hugs</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is wrapped in protective flames providing shields and movement speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting @ShieldCalc@ Shield and @MoveSpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Fired Up!</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been enchanted by Milio and will deal bonus damage and burn with their next attack or ability.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Fired Up!</titleLeft><mainText>This unit was struck by a champion enchanted by Milio and is taking damage over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: When Milio's Abilities touch ally champions, their next Attack or Ability deals <physicalDamage>@ADBurstRatio@ ally Attack Damage</physicalDamage> as additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>, plus <magicDamage>@BurnDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @BurnDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_MilioPassive_Tooltip}}

Burn damage does not stack from multiple hits.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ultra Mega Fire Kick</titleLeft><mainText>Knocked back by a ball of flames.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing @Damage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmountPercent@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with {{Spell_MilioKickballQ_Name}} refunds @RefundRatio*100@% of it's Mana cost.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Minions and monsters are knocked further and create a larger explosion.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ultra Mega Fire Kick</titleLeft><mainText>Slowed by a concussive blast.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Breath of Life</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has increased tenacity from being doused in Milio's soothing flames.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects, restoring <healing>@HealCalc@ Health</healing>, and granting @TenacityAmount*100@% Tenacity for @TenacityDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Cozy Campfire</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has increased attack range thanks to Milio's inspiration.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for @ZoneDuration@ seconds. Ally champions nearby gain @RangePercent@ Attack Range and restore @HealingOverTime@ Health over the duration. The hearth also applies {{Spell_MilioPassive_Name}} every @HealFrequencySeconds@ seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Milio instructs his buff zone to follow a new target.
